scope: 用户获知单独校正 tick 与恢复范围后要求继续；临时设置 ADJ_TICK=10000，计时通过后复验 A2，最终恢复起始 tick
authorization: 仅临时写 ADJ_TICK 与条件复验；不修改 freq、NTP 状态、系统时间或时钟源，不重启、构建、运行全量测试或发布
timex_source:
import ctypes, json, os, sys, time
from pathlib import Path
class Timeval(ctypes.Structure):
    _fields_ = [("tv_sec", ctypes.c_long), ("tv_usec", ctypes.c_long)]
class TimexPrefix(ctypes.Structure):
    _fields_ = [("modes", ctypes.c_uint), ("offset", ctypes.c_long), ("freq", ctypes.c_long),
                ("maxerror", ctypes.c_long), ("esterror", ctypes.c_long), ("status", ctypes.c_int),
                ("constant", ctypes.c_long), ("precision", ctypes.c_long), ("tolerance", ctypes.c_long),
                ("time", Timeval), ("tick", ctypes.c_long)]
assert ctypes.sizeof(ctypes.c_long) == 8
libc = ctypes.CDLL(None, use_errno=True)
libc.adjtimex.argtypes = [ctypes.c_void_p]
libc.adjtimex.restype = ctypes.c_int

buf = ctypes.create_string_buffer(1024)
mode = sys.argv[1]
if mode == 'set':
    requested = int(sys.argv[2])
    assert os.sysconf('SC_CLK_TCK') == 100 and 9000 <= requested <= 11000
    request = TimexPrefix.from_buffer(buf)
    request.modes = 0x4000
    request.tick = requested
else:
    assert mode == 'read'
result = libc.adjtimex(ctypes.byref(buf))
error = ctypes.get_errno()
value = TimexPrefix.from_buffer_copy(buf.raw)
print(json.dumps({'result': result, 'errno': error, 'modes_input': 0x4000 if mode == 'set' else 0,
                 'tick_us': value.tick, 'freq_scaled_ppm': value.freq, 'freq_ppm': value.freq / 65536,
                 'status': value.status, 'user_hz': os.sysconf('SC_CLK_TCK')}))

timing.guest_probe:
import ctypes, json, os, sys, time
from pathlib import Path
class Timeval(ctypes.Structure):
    _fields_ = [("tv_sec", ctypes.c_long), ("tv_usec", ctypes.c_long)]
class TimexPrefix(ctypes.Structure):
    _fields_ = [("modes", ctypes.c_uint), ("offset", ctypes.c_long), ("freq", ctypes.c_long),
                ("maxerror", ctypes.c_long), ("esterror", ctypes.c_long), ("status", ctypes.c_int),
                ("constant", ctypes.c_long), ("precision", ctypes.c_long), ("tolerance", ctypes.c_long),
                ("time", Timeval), ("tick", ctypes.c_long)]
assert ctypes.sizeof(ctypes.c_long) == 8
libc = ctypes.CDLL(None, use_errno=True)
libc.adjtimex.argtypes = [ctypes.c_void_p]
libc.adjtimex.restype = ctypes.c_int
for incoming in sys.stdin:
    buf = ctypes.create_string_buffer(1024)
    result = libc.adjtimex(ctypes.byref(buf))
    value = TimexPrefix.from_buffer_copy(buf.raw)
    print(json.dumps({
        "id": incoming.strip(),
        "monotonic_ns": str(time.clock_gettime_ns(time.CLOCK_MONOTONIC)),
        "raw_ns": str(time.clock_gettime_ns(time.CLOCK_MONOTONIC_RAW)),
        "realtime_ns": str(time.clock_gettime_ns(time.CLOCK_REALTIME)),
        "clocksource": Path("/sys/devices/system/clocksource/clocksource0/current_clocksource").read_text().strip(),
        "timex": {"modes_input": 0, "result": result, "errno": ctypes.get_errno(),
                  "user_hz": os.sysconf("SC_CLK_TCK"), "tick_us": value.tick,
                  "freq_scaled_ppm": value.freq, "freq_ppm": value.freq / 65536,
                  "status": value.status, "offset": value.offset}
    }), flush=True)
